name: stata-research-guard
description: Provides Stata main rules, a closed command dictionary, Stata 18 help-first evidence, and optional combined expanded documentation plus selected paper context.

interface.shortDescription: Stata 18 help-first command and research context.
interface.longDescription: Lets the model inspect a closed 109-command Stata dictionary, choose exact canonical commands, and retrieve only those commands' Stata 18-rendered official or maintainer help, factual expanded-documentation status, and compact paper profiles. When help is insufficient, combined Phase 3 supplies whole command entries from installed Stata 18 PDF manuals or a clearly limited author supplement, plus optional exact paper code and directly linked raw log or artifact excerpts. Commands outside the dictionary abort, while unavailable help is reported per command without hiding its paper catalog. The model decides whether to expand and which paper blocks to request. The plugin does not scan projects, score or rank candidates, promote templates, productize paper audits, grade generated code, or certify a research design.
defaultPrompt: Use the skill and get_stata_command_evidence to read the main rules and command dictionary, choose exact commands, then read their Stata 18-rendered help first.
Request combined expanded documentation and selected paper context only when the help does not fully settle the requested action or a worked source context would materially help.
Treat paper examples and optional raw logs as nonbinding source context; preserve the current project and selected research specification.
Proceed from help when it fully explains the requested action and the code follows directly; report material help gaps and do not treat paper examples as grammar authority.
